lead.titleZh: CMS更新DMEPOS竞标指南，射频微切与抗阻训练比较足底筋膜病疗效
lead.titleEn: CMS Updates DMEPOS Bidding Guide, RF Microtenotomy vs. Resistance for Plantar Fasciopathy
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 8 条更新，其中最高分（79分）条目来自行业与执业，提示了DMEPOS竞标项目的重要更新。临床方面，有三项 75 分的研究值得关注：一项 RCT 比较了射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练治疗顽固性足底筋膜病的疗效；另有两项观察研究分别涉及肢体缺失儿童的结局以及青少年特发性脊柱侧凸的主动自我矫正量化。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's update includes 8 entries, with the top-scoring item (79 points) from the industry and practice category, highlighting significant updates to the DMEPOS competitive bidding program. Clinically, three studies at 75 points are noteworthy: an RCT comparing radiofrequency microtenotomy with heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy, and two observational studies on outcomes for children with limb loss and quantitative active self-correction in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: Integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improved early postoperative LEFS at 4 weeks (+1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02 to 3.07, P = 0.047) in 128 patients, but this advantage diminished by week 12.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全膝关节置换术后常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，在早期（术后4周）对LEFS评分有小幅改善，但临床意义不明显，且优势不持久。在改变常规实践前，需要更强的证据和更长的随访。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对128名全膝关节置换术后患者的随机对照试验发现，在常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，可在术后4周适度改善下肢功能量表（LEFS）评分（+1.55分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P = 0.047），但此优势在12周时减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding hip-ankle training to conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improves early postoperative LEFS scores at 4 weeks, but the clinical significance is limited and the benefit is not sustained. Stronger evidence and longer follow-up are needed before altering routine practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，随访时间相对较短（12周），且主要结局的临床重要性阈值未明确达到。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a relatively short follow-up (12 weeks), and the clinical importance threshold for the primary outcome was not clearly met.

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for an RCT (n=36) to evaluate the added effect of an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome, focusing on postural angles as the primary outcome over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对“上交叉综合征”的随机对照试验方案，旨在验证个体化、分阶段的矫正运动方案的附加效果。该方案尝试标准化入组标准和干预内容，有助于提高研究可重复性。对肩颈姿势问题感兴趣的临床医师可以关注其后续研究结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的个体化系统矫正运动：一项随机对照试验方案。
items.summaryZh: 这是一项针对 36 名符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的随机对照试验方案，旨在评估个体化、系统知情矫正运动方案的附加效果，主要结局指标是 12 周后的姿势角度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an RCT on "upper crossed syndrome," aiming to validate the additive effect of individualized, staged corrective exercise. The protocol standardizes eligibility and interventions, which should improve reproducibility. Clinicians interested in shoulder-neck posture issues may follow its future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据，且其 4 周的随访期无法提供关于复发预防的长期推论。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol without actual results yet, and its 4-week follow-up period will not support long-term inferences about recurrence prevention.

items.title: Comparison of Radiofrequency Microtenotomy vs. Heavy-Slow Resistance for Refractory Plantar Fasciopathy: A Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=72) found no significant difference in FHSQ-DK pain domain mean change from baseline to 6 months between radiofrequency microtenotomy and heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy (mean difference −4.9, 95% CI −13.8; 4.0).
items.curatedReason: 对于顽固性足底筋膜病，这项RCT明确指出射频微切开术并不优于重慢速抗阻训练。这意味着对这类患者，运动疗法应作为首选干预，避免不必要的微创手术。
items.titleZh: 射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练治疗顽固性足底筋膜病的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=72）显示，对于顽固性足底筋膜病，射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练在6个月时FHSQ-DK疼痛域的平均变化无显著差异（平均差−4.9，95% CI −13.8; 4.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For refractory plantar fasciopathy, this RCT clearly indicates that radiofrequency microtenotomy is not superior to heavy-slow resistance training. This suggests that exercise therapy should be the preferred intervention for these patients, avoiding unnecessary minimally invasive surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究的随访时间为6个月，未能评估长期疗效；且部分患者退出可能影响了最终分析的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was 6 months, not allowing for long-term efficacy assessment, and patient dropouts may have affected the precision of the final analysis.

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis (n=56) of children with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life (median PedsQL 72.3/100.0), but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0). Unilateral lower limb loss was associated with superior adjustment and prosthetic satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 大地震两年后，儿童截肢者的肢体功能、社会功能和学校相关生活质量表现良好，但情感健康仍受影响，提示康复服务应整合长期心理健康支持。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震两年后肢体缺失儿童的身体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 56 名地震相关肢体缺失儿童的回顾性分析显示，截肢 2.3 年后，其身体、社会和学校相关生活质量良好（PedsQL 中位数 72.3/100.0），但情感功能较低（60.0/100.0）。单侧下肢缺失的儿童表现出更好的适应性和假肢满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years post-earthquake, children with limb loss showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remained affected. This highlights the need for integrated long-term mental health support within rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，样本来自单一康复中心，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective analysis with samples from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias and data completeness limitations.

items.title: GLIM-defined malnutrition and frailty in older outpatients with diabetes
items.summary: Among 391 older outpatients with diabetes, GLIM-defined malnutrition was prevalent in 33% and independently associated with frailty (OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007), according to a retrospective study.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示，在患有糖尿病的老年门诊患者中，GLIM标准定义的营养不良非常普遍（33%），且与衰弱独立相关。这提示你在对老年糖尿病患者进行综合老年评估时，应高度关注营养不良和衰弱的筛查与管理，以支持更个体化的临床干预。
items.titleZh: GLIM定义的营养不良与糖尿病老年门诊患者的衰弱
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究显示，在391名糖尿病老年门诊患者中，33%存在GLIM定义的营养不良，且营养不良与衰弱独立相关（OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that GLIM-defined malnutrition is highly prevalent (33%) and independently associated with frailty in older outpatients with diabetes. This suggests that when conducting comprehensive geriatric assessments for older diabetic patients, you should prioritize screening and managing malnutrition and frailty to support more individualized clinical interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, which cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational study found that the Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, though no single test was sufficiently strong alone. Combining tests with fall history (AUC 0.89-0.97) improved model fit.
items.curatedReason: TUG 和 FSST 在预测老年人跌倒风险方面表现出最高的区分度，但单一测试的效能不足以独立预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合使用可提高预测准确性。
items.titleZh: 功能性活动能力测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效用
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究发现，计时起立行走测试（TUG，AUC=0.777）和四方步进测试（FSST，AUC=0.771）在预测老年人跌倒方面具有最高的区分度，但单一测试不足以可靠预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合（AUC 0.89-0.97）可提高模型拟合度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TUG and FSST showed the highest discrimination for fall risk in older adults, but individual tests were insufficient for standalone prediction. Combining functional tests with fall history improved predictive accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性队列研究，样本量相对较小，且功能测试与跌倒史结合的发现需外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational cohort study with a relatively small sample size, and the findings regarding combining functional tests with fall history require external validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Radiographic quantification of active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises and its potential prognostic value in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
items.summary: A prospective study (n=not specified) found that active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises (PSSE) resulted in 27.32% Cobb angle correction (from 37.57° to 28.82°) and was the only variable significantly associated with 6-month post-treatment Cobb angle change.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究首次放射学量化了特发性脊柱侧凸患者在PSSE训练中的主动自我矫正（ASC）程度，并发现其与6个月后的Cobb角变化相关。这提示在临床中评估患者的自我矫正能力，可能有助于预测治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动中主动自我矫正的影像学量化及其在青少年特发性脊柱侧凸中的潜在预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性研究（n=未注明）发现，物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动（PSSE）中的主动自我矫正可使Cobb角矫正27.32%（从37.57°至28.82°），且是唯一与6个月治疗后Cobb角变化显著相关的变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study for the first time radiographically quantified active self-correction (ASC) during PSSE in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and found it correlated with Cobb angle change at 6 months. This suggests that assessing patients' self-correction ability in practice may help predict treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小，且随访期为6个月，尚不能完全评估长期预后价值。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and the 6-month follow-up period is insufficient to fully assess long-term prognostic value.

items.title: CMS Posts Bidder Licensure Guide for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program & Updates to HCPCS Level II Code Classifications for Certain Leg and Arm Braces | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program
items.summary: CMS has posted the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, effective December 1, 2026, reclassifying L1833, L1851, L1852, and L3761 from off-the-shelf to requiring professional fitting.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目（CBP）的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，明确这些矫形器不再符合“现成”定义，需要由专业人员适配。这直接影响DMEPOS供应商的投标策略和PT/OT执业者选择和报销相关矫形器的实践。
items.titleZh: CMS发布2028年DMEPOS竞标项目投标者执照指南并更新部分腿臂矫形器HCPCS Level II编码分类
items.summaryZh: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，自2026年12月1日起，将L1833、L1851、L1852和L3761从“现成”重新分类为需专业人员适配。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program (CBP) and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, clarifying that these braces no longer meet the “off-the-shelf” definition and require fitting by a qualified professional. This directly impacts DMEPOS suppliers' bidding strategies and the practice of PT/OT professionals in selecting and billing for these braces.
